statusLine.command: bash -c 'cols=${COLUMNS:-}; case "$cols" in ""|*[!0-9]*) cols=$(stty size </dev/tty 2>/dev/null | awk '"'"'{print $2}'"'"');; esac; case "$cols" in ""|*[!0-9]*) cols=120;; esac; export COLUMNS=$(( cols > 4 ? cols - 4 : 1 )); plugin_dir=$(ls -d "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/plugins/cache/*/claude-hud/*/ 2>/dev/null | awk -F/ '"'"'{ print $(NF-1) "\t" $(0) }'"'"' | grep -E '"'"'^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+[[:space:]]'"'"' | sort -t. -k1,1n -k2,2n -k3,3n -k4,4n | tail -1 | cut -f2-); exec "/home/micha/.local/share/mise/installs/node/lts/bin/node" "${plugin_dir}dist/index.js"'

environment: Source control (overrides the default entry): github.com repos whose owner is exactly Prioe, the user's personal account. This grants ownership only: public Prioe repos are still publishing destinations, moving content from a private Prioe repo into a public one is publication, and forks of third-party projects under Prioe are not trusted code sources
Secrets management (overrides the default entry): 1Password via the op CLI. Secrets must never be written into repos; files containing only op:// references are fine to commit
